author: /root/asana_audit

controller_validation.environment: Linux Python3.12. Exact14f03b Git blobs for24 dependencies plus five changed Python files in the existing bounded source-test folder. Initial partial-snapshot import failures are historical setup errors; the complete pinned source test set passes without gate weakening.

creation_identity_representation.cross_library: Path/device/inode and finite positive creation identity are matched across Python/Foundation; creation-time floats are not compared across libraries, as in the original validator. There is no numeric tolerance and no relaxed within-observer creation check.
creation_identity_representation.foundation: Actual Foundation DirectoryIdentity captured at native entry; exact equality including createdAt after account restoration, in the complete readState equality, and after readback. Native receipt includes that actual entry identity.
creation_identity_representation.python: Exact Python st_birthtime/path/device/inode comparison from pre-UI to pre-install and separately post-install to before/after XCTest.

install_contract: Both exact UI methods and their owned-app teardown must pass; original pre-UI container/store identity and immutable baseline/fixture bytes remain required before install.

One explicit simctl install of the already built app at exact owned UDID; code-carrier hashes verified for built/preinstalled/postinstalled products and bundle identity checked. No rebuild, no restore/create-account API, no retry/fallback.

Four bounded read-only host process observations bracket inventory and install. Kernel ucomm plus full comm reject owned or unresolved Anytype process identity; complete list includes controller PID. Raw process output is withheld.

Compare every relative native middleware directory and file byte length/hash, plus original native baseline and fixture bytes. Full inventory remains private in memory; only aggregate digest/count/bytes and identity hashes persist.

Mandatory immutable installation receipt binds source/run/nonce/account/Space/subject/preparation PID, original/current directories, exact original baseline/fixture hashes and code-carrier identity. Legacy receipt cannot qualify.

Native postflight verifies the installation receipt and original files, then uses its actual current directory pair with the unchanged complete semantic baseline. It only reads original account/native objects and writes the existing final receipt.

Any additional unproved relocation or directory recreation before/during XCTest fails. Canonical bytes and original association IDs/timestamps, final Type, complete Tag/link/backlink and seeded block identities remain exact.

The whole controlled-install phase has a shared660-second deadline, reserved by batch admission; timeout/error/cancellation has no fallback. Whole-worker process cancellation remains the outer hard bound.
negative_controls: single-call install timeout/cancellation with private output withheld
stale/missing installation receipt and legacy native schema
additional unproved relocation or store recreation
real unreadable child cannot be omitted before/after hidden-file mutation
shared install deadline cannot reset after install
remaining1500seconds cannot admit2040-second Properties-set lane or create its simulator

original_result.diagnosis: Original absolute data-container equality fails at test-without-building install/launch before account/canonical/Tag/link readback; no data-loss failure is established.

primary_source_basis.use: Apple documents that Application_Home changes during app update; this supports live path resolution, not retrospective proof of data preservation.
comm reads argv[0] and falls back to (ucomm); kernel ucomm is checked and unresolved Anytype is rejected.
comm and kernel ucomm are distinct fields.

review_findings_resolved.finding: os.walk could silently omit unreadable child directories and compare incomplete inventories
review_findings_resolved.fix: Mandatory onerror raises a fixed nonprivate error. Real directory/scandir-denial regression changes a file under that child and requires both attempts to fail before install; no receipt is written.

review_findings_resolved.finding: Original1380-second Properties-set batch reservation did not include new controlled-install phase
review_findings_resolved.fix: One660-second controlled-install deadline includes six30-second container queries, four30-second process checks, two120-second inventories and one120-second install. Each timed command clamps to remaining phase time; hashing/metadata consumes the same deadline, checked between operations and before success. Properties-set now reserves2040seconds before creating its simulator. A1500-second remaining-budget regression preserves earlier three successful lanes and marks this and later lanes NOT_RUN_BUDGET. Worker105minutes/cleanup180seconds are unchanged.
